result.rejection_reason: Gate 4 failed one EV window, independent sample size (six quarterly decisions total; two per window), old/mid replacement value, top-five positive-PnL concentration (76.11% versus 60% cap), and cash conservation.

calibration.surprise_note: Aggregate diagnostic EV and PnL were positive, but that apparent improvement was concentrated in late_strong and in correlated issuer legs rather than independent release decisions.

result.production_impact: Default-off paper snapshot only: trade_enabled=false, orders=[], and no live/default orders, ranking, sizing, exits, or capital allocation changed.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The small additive gain was late-window-driven, based on six correlated quarterly decisions rather than 41 independent issuer legs, concentrated in five winners, and measured without funding displacement.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retune issuer identity, serious-outcome definition, case-count or volume-ratio guards, delta threshold, rank/top-N, entry timing, hold length, notional, or trading cost on the same frozen quarters; do not count issuer legs as independent decisions.
